integrationStatus: Art contract for Claude. No engine integration is implemented by this file.

coordinates.boneRestFrames: Use this seated 15-joint model rest, including the corrected rider and shoulder placement. Original 13 names remain; local XYZ is not model XYZ. Use supplied absolute GLB tracks.

invariants.geometryOwnership: model lane; motion appends samples without changing existing packed data

engineHandoff.load: Use GLTFLoader result.animations with one AnimationMixer per SkeletonUtils clone. Root mixer at the cloned common scene root, keeping skeleton and mesh together.
engineHandoff.clock: Advance once per unpaused render clock step. Reset actions, holds, event cooldowns and faces on a new race.
engineHandoff.blend: Normal absolute clips. One primary full-rig action at a time. Keep actions running through crossfades; never rebase rest transforms from an animated pose.
disableProcedural: reaction body squash, twist, hit tilt, boost pitch and visual lift
FX spin when spin_out owns rotation
kartPose hitMotion yaw, roll and lift during owned reaction channels
kartPose fireMotion pitch during owned cast channels
retainProcedural: host race root position/quaternion from interpolated state
material tint, ghost wash, faces and marks
steering bank only when lean_left/right is not the selected primary action
engineHandoff.postBlendGrounding: Resolve cumulative assembly gaps, cup-foot clearance, sole-floor planting and supported palm-brim targets after blending. A root-only lift does not repair these relative contacts. Do not layer independent whole-body reactions or restart a canonical landing after a partial takeoff.

controls.kart_root: Whole visual orientation only, no world flight arc
controls.rider_mount: Whole seated rider relative to cup
controls.EMI_root: Secondary body rotation within the contact envelope

assembly.hierarchy: cup_body, saucer_body and rider_mount are siblings under kart_root. Resolve skin joints by name, never by numeric order.

gapCoordinates.saucerY: seat-center vertical offset before common support grounding
gapCoordinates.cupY: nonnegative minimum signed cup-foot clearance along the tilted saucer seat normal
gapCoordinates.riderGap: nonnegative minimum sole clearance above actual cup floor

assembly.composition: Cup and saucer rotate independently about the rest seat center in model space. Evaluate the tilted saucer seat point and normal. Translate cup and rider together along that normal until the minimum actual cup-foot signed-plane gap equals cupY. Compose rider from the evaluated cup, then correct the actual sole minimum along the cup floor normal to riderGap. Keep planted rider rigid to cup except constrained yaw. Finally ground the common rig along world-Y; root grounding alone does not repair relative contacts.

contactGeometry.coordinateSystem: glTF mesh space, meters, Y up, forward -Z

componentControls.kart_root: Rigid whole-kart visual orientation only; engine owns track/world trajectory.
componentControls.rider_mount: Whole rider relative translation; all original EMI descendants follow.

reviewLimits.note: Conservative initial motion envelope. Validate all exported samples; full emergence requires sole-to-floor gap greater than the 0.19 m floor-to-brim depth.

sampling.reason: Contact-dense assembly tracks follow the changing lowest cup-foot support patch as opposite slopes cross. Runtime uses authored timestamps, not the authoring frame count.

opposingWobble.interpolation: quintic smoothstep between scalar knots; opposing rebound decays to exact rest

interpolation.scalar: quintic smoothstep: E(x)=x^3*(x*(6*x-15)+10), with x clamped to 0..1
interpolation.quaternion: normalized shortest-arc slerp between adjacent authored timestamps; assembly tracks use 120 fps keys, other tracks 30 fps. Preserve full-turn root sampling
interpolation.scale: Unit component scale. No body or cup squash changes contact geometry.

landingAdapter.trigger: real land event immediately, regardless of current visual priority
capture: actual evaluated saucer seat-center offset excluding common root grounding
minimum signed cup-foot gap against tilted seat plane
saucer rotation quaternion relative to rest
cup rotation quaternion relative to rest
rider rotation quaternion relative to cup/rest
actual arm and antenna local rotations
landingAdapter.normalizedTime: u=clamp(secondsSinceLand / durationSec), duration 0.6 soft or 0.8 heavy

envelopes.riderRotation: Slerp captured rider delta to identity by E(u/feetSeat), then gate pitch/roll by actual sole gap and solve planting
envelopes.hands: Blend captured free-arm pose into landing arm pose over the first 0.18 normalized time. Regrip over u=0.63..0.83 with exact brim solve; do not move already planted feet.
envelopes.antenna: Blend captured pose into delayed landing response over first 0.18 normalized time, then decay to exact rest at u=1
envelopes.pulse: E((u-start)/(peak-start)) until peak; hold through hold; 1-E((u-hold)/(end-hold)) until end; zero outside

invariants: zero incoming gap remains zero within the 0.2 mm interpolation tolerance; post-sampling contact correction removes the residual
partial gap cannot open to the canonical 90/240 mm
cup seats before released soles, then hands regrip
already planted soles remain planted even if cup still has a small gap
restore every local rest transform at final sample
landingAdapter.implementation: Clone/adapt assembly tracks or evaluate these envelopes against the current model rest and contact patches. Recompute tilted-seat and cup-floor clearance after pose interpolation and blending. This JSON is an art integration contract, not an implemented engine adapter.

gentle.method: Scale semantic gap and rotation envelopes before solving, then solve the same cumulative floor/brim contacts. Free-pitch gate remains at 0.23 m, so half-height jumps have no free body tilt. Do not slow physical assembly transitions.
gentle.fallback: If contact adaptation is unavailable, keep the entire assembly and rider at coherent rest, retain face/static mark cues, and fade those for at least0.3s.

assembly.off: One coherent assembled rest pose. No repeated rocking, separation or antenna motion. Physics still moves the common host root.

signalNormalization.localSim: Player events arrive directly; racer defaults to 0.
signalNormalization.botSim: Unwrap racer-event {racer,name,p}; use its inner p as payload and retain racer.
signalNormalization.deduplicate: Use either bus event or state-edge fallback per transition, not both. A single land may accompany a physical bounce; do not restart continuously from grounded state.
signalNormalization.bumpSide: Transform payload.p minus racer root position by inverse racer root quaternion. Negative local X selects bump_left; nonnegative selects bump_right. For wall, side is track-lateral rather than kart-local: transform track.frameAt(st[S.s]).b multiplied by payload.side by the inverse racer quaternion, then use its local X sign. This also handles reversed racers.
signalNormalization.racePhase: race.phase is the existing sim/race.js object held by boot.js. It is not currently passed in world.update(view); the adapter must expose it, and must clear countdown immediately on the existing go bus event even without that fallback.
signalNormalization.heldItem: Read view.items.held[] matching racer index. item-roll starts armed presentation; item-fire clears it. Existing view.karts[i] does not include item state.
signalNormalization.maxSpeed: There is no max-speed event. Derive the hysteresis state from S.speedPct. Thresholds are art defaults.
signalNormalization.ramp: airborne cause lip distinguishes a ramp/lip launch from a button hop. No slope-entry event exists; grounded slope alignment remains engine-owned.
signalNormalization.boost: boost-start kind can be drift (tier 0..3), pad, launch, slip, surge, bubble or trick. For B1 granted boosts boost-end may say pad; match the racer active state rather than kind equality.

faceAtlas.blink: Existing procedural canvas supports blink; the current atlas branch ignores blink. No additional blink texture is supplied.

unboundItemModes.drop: Small ready-to-rest release; no new throwing claim.
unboundItemModes.wide: Release item_ready into happy face; host effect owns the outward wave.
unboundItemModes.self: Use boost_recoil for surge; grin/smug/heart face for glass/echo/golden without a fake throw.
